name: DawnAwakens
camera: The camera slowly cranes up and back to reveal the whole ridge, the ten sisters, the dragons in the sky and the empty band across the top.
audio: a low rising orchestral swell, deep war drums, a distant dragon's roar and shimmering magic chimes; no speech
subject: The first frame shows the ten sisters of Sovereign Territories standing together on a shattered obsidian ridge at dawn, each wreathed in her own element, with ancient dragons in the clouds above.
world: The whole landscape wakes: mist drifts across the ridge, god-rays shift through the clouds, embers and petals and frost and sparks swirl on the wind, and the ten glowing elemental territories far below pulse with light.
constraints: Keep all ten women, their faces, gowns and positions exactly as in the first frame; no new people, no cuts, smooth natural motion, no text, no subtitles, no logos.

actions.beat: Golden dawn light spreads across the ridge from the right as the ten elemental territories far below pulse awake one after another.

Each sister's element ignites around her in turn from left to right: flames flare, frost crystals bloom, vines unfurl, lightning crackles, venom mist coils, shadow smoke rolls, water swirls, golden light blooms, stones lift and wind ribbons stream.
The ancient dragons among the clouds bank and roar as the camera rises, leaving the clear band of sky across the top of the frame empty for the title.

notes: Reel and title-screen background: the key art coming alive. Feed the rendered poster as the source image.
